limitations: 06_world/world.sqlite admits WORLD relations only; purpose-scoped semantic judgments (entity_identity_judgment, invoice_counterparty_association, commercial_dependency_assertion) are read from 05_dispositions.json at compile time.
contract_clause_present has four UNRESOLVED exclusivity obligations with no world tuple; exclusivity cannot be asserted or rejected for those contracts from world data alone.

identity_link_candidate and invoice_contract_association_candidate re-derivation seeds from invoice_counterparty_association dispositions and expands via entity_identity_judgment pairs; mechanical-only name matching alone does not recover all candidates (e.g. Helion Ltd./Limited punctuation, Northbridge Inc. comma variant).

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Mechanical filter; no unresolved disposition field. Closed invoices simply absent from output.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: COMPLETE over invoice_record universe; every invoice row is classified open or not-open by source status literal.
derivations.deterministic_computation: SELECT invoice_id FROM invoice_record WHERE status = 'open'

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Candidate enumeration only; emits endpoint pairs requiring Purpose B judgment without asserting SAME_ENTITY, DISTINCT, or UNRESOLVED.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: COMPLETE over commercial-relationship clusters seeded from invoice-to-contract associations; each cluster spans billing, CRM, governing contract, and registry candidates for that relationship.
derivations.deterministic_computation: Seed clusters from invoice_counterparty_association (invoice billed_name + contract); expand each cluster by closure over entity_identity_judgment endpoint pairs; emit sorted C(n,2) pairs within each cluster.
derivations.required_premise: invoice_record for billed_name lookup; invoice_counterparty_association dispositions to seed billing-contract commercial nexus per relationship
derivations.optional_enrichment: entity_identity_judgment disposition pairs from 05_dispositions.json used to expand clusters to required CRM and registry candidate endpoints; mechanical legal_form_name_variant alone is insufficient for full topology
non_blocking_unresolved_state: entity_identity_judgment UNRESOLVED on registry candidates still generates candidate pairs; unresolved identity is the judgment target, not a blocker for candidate emission

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Semantic disposition per candidate pair: SAME_ENTITY (ACCEPT), DISTINCT (REJECT), or UNRESOLVED. Missing positive same-entity evidence is not DISTINCT.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: One judgment per identity_link_candidate pair from the Purpose B required topology.
derivations.deterministic_computation: Lookup P5 disposition for each candidate pair; disposition vocabulary maps ACCEPT->SAME_ENTITY, REJECT->DISTINCT, UNRESOLVED->UNRESOLVED.
derivations.required_premise: identity_link_candidate universe; 05_dispositions.json adjudication for each pair
derivations.optional_enrichment: WORLD name and registry records provide grounding context but do not override disposition outcomes
non_blocking_unresolved_state: UNRESOLVED registry links for Northbridge (billing/contract/crm vs registry:2019-0008841 and registry:3840192) are valid non-blocking output epistemic values

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Candidate invoice-contract pairs whose billed name and counterparty may correspond; no association disposition emitted at this stage.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Include every invoice-contract pair with mechanical name correspondence or shared commercial-relationship cluster membership.
derivations.deterministic_computation: Union of (a) SQL join on exact billed_name/counterparty_name or legal_form_name_variant rows and (b) pairs where billing:billed_name and contract share a commercial cluster from identity closure.
derivations.required_premise: invoice_record and contract_header; legal_form_name_variant for documented mechanical variants
derivations.optional_enrichment: invoice_counterparty_association dispositions and entity_identity_judgment cluster expansion recover pairs not matched by mechanical SQL alone

derivations.epistemic_behavior: asserted when billed_name and contract counterparty confidently same party; unresolved otherwise. No negative association finding.
derivations.deterministic_computation: Lookup P5 disposition; ACCEPT maps to association asserted, UNRESOLVED maps to association unresolved.
derivations.required_premise: invoice_contract_association_candidate universe; 05_dispositions.json for each invoice-contract pair
derivations.optional_enrichment: entity_identity_judgment SAME_ENTITY between billing:billed_name and contract endpoint supports asserted linkage
non_blocking_unresolved_state: association unresolved does not exclude invoice from Purpose A output; it is a non-blocking epistemic field on qualifying invoices

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Enumerates counterparty-contract pairs that may satisfy Purpose C (open invoice on billing counterparty plus active auto-renewing or rolling contract, or unresolved joins blocking evaluation).
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Emit billing: counterparty identifier for each open-invoice commercial relationship with its governing active contract that has auto_renewal_term or rolling_term present, plus pairs where identity join remains unresolved.
derivations.deterministic_computation: For each open invoice, resolve governing contract via invoice_counterparty_association; emit (billing:billed_name, contract) when contract is active and has rolling_term or auto_renewal_term present=true.
derivations.required_premise: open_invoice, invoice_record, contract_lifecycle_status active filter, contract_clause_present for term kinds
derivations.optional_enrichment: invoice_counterparty_association and entity_identity_judgment dispositions for contract resolution when mechanical join insufficient

derivations.epistemic_behavior: dependent when current relationship (open invoice OR active auto-renew/rolling contract) AND obligation kind (exclusivity, auto_renewal, rolling_term) both satisfied with resolved identity joins; unresolved otherwise. No dependent=false output.
derivations.deterministic_computation: Lookup P5 disposition; ACCEPT maps to status dependent. Compiler also verifies open_invoice_ids and obligation_kinds from world clause tuples.
derivations.required_premise: dependency_evaluation_candidate universe; resolved invoice-contract association for counterparty; active contract lifecycle; at least one obligation clause present=true among exclusivity/auto_renewal_term/rolling_term
blocking_unresolved_state: entity_identity_judgment UNRESOLVED on billing-to-contract path blocks dependent assertion when join required
non_blocking_unresolved_state: entity_identity_judgment UNRESOLVED on billing-to-registry links does not block dependent when billing-to-contract and invoice-contract joins are resolved (Northbridge case)
contract_clause_present UNRESOLVED exclusivity on contracts that have other present obligation kinds does not block dependent when auto_renewal or rolling_term is present

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Lists every invoice whose counterparty has an active contract with at least one acquisition-relevant clause present=true. association field asserted or unresolved; unresolved association does not suppress inclusion.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Coverage of all invoices linked to active contracts bearing acquisition-relevant conditions per Purpose A policy; expired SOW excluded as inactive.
derivations.deterministic_computation: Filter invoices with candidate association to contracts where lifecycle status=active AND any acquisition-relevant clause_kind has present=true; map association from invoice_counterparty_association disposition.
derivations.required_premise: invoice_record fields; active contract_lifecycle_status; acquisition-relevant contract_clause_present present=true; invoice_contract_association_candidate covering invoice-contract nexus

derivations.epistemic_behavior: One link per identity_link_candidate with epistemic SAME_ENTITY, DISTINCT, or UNRESOLVED from entity_identity_judgment.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Every required topology link appears with exactly one epistemic value.
derivations.deterministic_computation: Map identity_link_candidate pairs through entity_identity_judgment dispositions; sort by left then right.
derivations.required_premise: identity_link_candidate universe; entity_identity_judgment dispositions for every candidate pair
non_blocking_unresolved_state: UNRESOLVED epistemic on Northbridge registry candidate links

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Per counterparty-contract pair: aggregate open_invoice_ids and obligation_kinds; status dependent or unresolved. Unresolved identity or join yields unresolved, not false.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Every dependency_evaluation_candidate compiled; obligation_kinds sorted ascending within each row; dependencies sorted by contract_id.
derivations.deterministic_computation: For each candidate, collect open invoices for billing counterparty on that contract; map present clause kinds to exclusivity/auto_renewal/rolling_term; status from commercial_dependency_assertion disposition.
derivations.required_premise: dependency_evaluation_candidate universe; open_invoice linkage; contract_clause_present for obligation kinds; commercial_dependency_assertion disposition
blocking_unresolved_state: commercial_dependency_assertion unresolved or missing when criteria not met with resolved joins
non_blocking_unresolved_state: UNRESOLVED exclusivity clause presence does not remove auto_renewal or rolling_term from obligation_kinds when those tuples are present=true
